g.text: Jennifer Lawrence Quotes ‘The Hunger Games’ While Urging Fans to Vote on Election Day: ‘Don’t Forget Who Burns With Us’ ◆ Kurosawa Award Winner O Mipo Is ‘Making Up for Lost Time’ After Career Break to Raise Her Sons ◆ ‘Cher Adores Michael Douglas,’ Icon’s Rep Says After Douglas Disses Her Oscar Win for ‘Moonstruck’ ◆ Oscar Predictions: Animated Feature — A New and Competitive Era for the Medium That Isn’t Just for Kids ◆ ‘The Elder Scrolls 6’ Title Revealed (Gaming News Roundup) ◆ Netflix Orders YA Drama ‘Prep’ Based on Curtis Sittenfeld Novel From Nicole Taylor ◆
